reproduction_contract.child: Parent observes exact launched PID and successful Welcome markers at the selected gate.
reproduction_contract.late_message: Gate releases after launch-return plus handshake timeout; parent waits for completed send without supervisor polling.
reproduction_contract.positive_controls: Same real fixture reaches Ready and obtains a revocable lease for control-Hello, progress-Hello and Ready gates released on time.
reproduction_contract.negative_controls: Late first Hello, split-lane late progress Hello and late Ready never gain a lease and are reaped with HandshakeTimeout.
reproduction_contract.clock_and_budget: Private tests cover exact deadline, zero read budget, stale outer poll time, credential disposal and unchanged Ready-worker health behavior.

limits: Real supervisor/startup cases run on Linux; zero-gated tests on other platforms do not qualify platform authentication.
Public low-level authentication hardening, secret erasure, additional negative cases and Windows/macOS supervisor support remain.
An admission deadline does not bound a blocking spawn/bootstrap system call.
Published exact-source CI and independent whole-task acceptance remain separate gates.
